@everyone

Land Plot Overlaps & Reporting

Hey everyone! We wanted to give you a quick update regarding land plots and fences.

We’re aware that there are currently some cases where land plots and/or fences appear to overlap. The fences you see right now are temporary and are being used while we conduct performance testing. They are not representative of how the final land system will work.

In the future, these temporary fences will be removed and you’ll have full control over your own land boundaries, including the ability to place your own fences and other objects at the heights and positions you choose.

  Please Only Report Issues on Your Own Land

To help our team investigate issues efficiently and avoid duplicate reports, please only submit bug reports for issues affecting land plots that you personally own.

Thanks for helping us keep testing focused and useful!
